exposure: antenatal Group B Streptococcus (GBS) screening status
outcome: adherence to CDC guidelines for intrapartum antibiotic prophylaxis (IAP)
appropriateness of IAP (totally appropriate, inappropriate antibiotic, partially appropriate)
cohort: The study included 902 women in Italy who were undergoing labor or delivery and had various Group B Streptococcus screening statuses.
finding: Only 36.3% of deliveries received totally appropriate intrapartum antibiotic prophylaxis, with adherence being significantly more likely in women who had no previous live birth, had a vaginal delivery, and had a positive antenatal GBS screening result.
mod_finding: Totally appropriate prophylaxis was significantly more likely in women who had a vaginal delivery.
